statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are suggestive of paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The patient is on current antiarrhythmic therapy
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was for continuous rhythm monitoring
The diagnoses addressed are I47.1 and I49.9
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
